mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide can cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia which may potentiate atomoxetine's sympathomimetic effects and increase cardiovascular risk; atomoxetine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and hydrochlorothiazide may affect electrolyte balance affecting drug efficacy.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and electrolytes (particularly potassium and sodium) regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive if significant electrolyte disturbances occur.
